seoTitle: Connect a Namecheap Domain to Squarespace
metaDescription: Built your site on Squarespace but bought your domain on Namecheap? Learn how to connect them with the right DNS records without transferring the domain.
intro: If your domain lives at Namecheap but your website is built on Squarespace, you don't need to transfer the domain to connect the two. This guide covers accessing your Namecheap DNS settings, adding the CNAME and A records Squarespace requires, and verifying the connection.

steps.heading: Access your Namecheap DNS settings
steps.body: Log in to Namecheap and open the Advanced DNS section for the domain you want to connect to Squarespace.

steps.heading: Get the required records from Squarespace
steps.body: In your Squarespace domain settings, find the specific CNAME and A records Squarespace provides for connecting third-party domains.

steps.heading: Add the CNAME and A records in Namecheap
steps.body: Enter the records exactly as provided by Squarespace into your Namecheap DNS panel, replacing any conflicting existing entries.

steps.heading: Handle SSL setup
steps.body: Once the domain connects, allow Squarespace to issue and apply an SSL certificate so your site loads securely over HTTPS.

steps.heading: Verify the domain connection
steps.body: After propagation, check that your Squarespace site loads correctly when visiting your Namecheap domain.

faq.question: Do I need to transfer my domain to use it with Squarespace?
faq.answer: No, you can keep your domain registered with Namecheap and simply point its DNS records to Squarespace.

faq.question: How long does DNS propagation take for this setup?
faq.answer: It varies, but it's worth allowing some time and avoiding assuming an issue if the connection doesn't work within the first few minutes.

faq.question: Will SSL be set up automatically?
faq.answer: Squarespace typically issues an SSL certificate automatically once the domain is properly connected via DNS.

faq.question: What if my domain doesn't connect right away?
faq.answer: Double-check that the CNAME and A records match exactly what Squarespace provided, as small mismatches are the most common cause of delays.
